info.title: casmi26-v4b-models
info.description:
CASMI 2026 v4b assets: v1 engine code + fe_v4 families/tables, FPNet A/B, DreamsFP D (see LICENSE-NOTICE.txt), LightGBM ranker, MANIFEST.json.

Source note: contains data and/or models derived from the Enveda CASMI26 competition training data (which includes CC BY-NC licensed components) and COCONUT (CC BY 4.0). Use under the respective source licenses (non-commercial, with attribution).

info.title: casmi26-fpnet-full1
info.description: FPNet (spectrum -> fingerprint) trained on ALL train folds incl. np-examples, same architecture as the casmi26-v4b-models engine FPNet A (drop-in). Source note: trained on the Enveda CASMI26 competition training data (which includes CC BY-NC licensed components). Use under the source licenses (non-commercial, with attribution).

info.title: casmi26-glacier
info.description: GLACIER (ms-pred, MassSpecGym checkpoint, MIT) as an offline isomer re-scorer for the CASMI26 notebook: subprocess runner gl_runner.py (fork of casmi26-iceberg ice_runner.py), notebook glue gl_fuse.py (run_gl, rerank_multi), ms_pred inference subset (MIT), pure-torch DGL / torch_scatter / LinSATNet stand-ins, stripped checkpoint. Reuses the casmi26-iceberg wheels. See README.md and LICENSE-NOTICE.txt.
